title: HOLD-LC-001 time-segmented response-history owner candidates
question: Do the exact N0/B0 rsp2 products add a time-segmented response owner candidate and event-window coverage without being mistaken for calibration validity, a timing likelihood or covariance?
method: Acquire exactly the N0 and B0 event-trigger rsp2 products from the official bn170817529/current directory into the gitignored cache.
Byte-freeze both products with official locators, roles, lengths and SHA-256 values in a separate tracked manifest; leave the earlier owner-artifact manifest immutable.

Run the self-tested audit_hold_lc_response_history.py. Verify hashes and inspect only FITS scalar headers and table declarations: one EBOUNDS table, eight numbered SPECRESP MATRIX segments, required response columns, TT-second coverage and trigger context. Read no EBOUNDS or response-matrix values.
Repeat byte, HDU, segment-number, required-column and coverage checks with an independent PowerShell parser.
Mutate the expected SHA-256 of the selected B0 response-history product and require the primary audit to return nonzero.

Keep response values, calibration validity/interpolation, detector-to-geocenter conversion, likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, maps, score and prospective credit stopped; preserve the established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods and owner order.

exact_scope.extraction_scope: FITS scalar headers and table declarations only; no EBOUNDS values, response-matrix values, event rows, timing fit or score.
exact_scope.finite_scope: Finite exact response-history owner-provenance and schema intake; no continuum, physical identity or prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 response-history intake; no change to T-054/T-059 methods, owner order or promotion firewalls.

checks.detail: Synthetic EBOUNDS/response segment schema, numbered segment ordering and coverage rules passed.
Both rsp2 products match their frozen SHA-256/byte lengths; each declares one EBOUNDS HDU, eight numbered SPECRESP MATRIX HDUs, required columns and TT-second coverage. Matrix values were not read.
Independent PowerShell byte/hash/header parser reproduced size, hash, hdu=10, ebounds=1, matrices=8, rsp=1..8 and coverage=10 for N0 and B0.
Changing the expected SHA-256 of FERMI-GBM-EVENT-TRIGGER-RSP2-B0 caused the primary audit to return nonzero; the selected mutation was rejected.
No T-054/T-059 authority, candidate card, result, negative, physical-empty input or Lean theorem was edited or promoted.

finding: The exact N0/B0 rsp2 products cross the generic-owner-search boundary by supplying hash-pinned time-segmented response-history candidates with one EBOUNDS table and eight numbered response segments per detector, all declared in TT seconds over the event-trigger window. This narrows the physical-owner request, but header/schema presence does not admit response values, validity/interpolation, detector-to-geocenter conversion, a timing likelihood, covariance or intrinsic-emission nuisance law.
decision_reason: This is a new exact trigger-product locator and byte hash with primary, independent and hostile checks. The result advances response-owner lineage only; it does not repeat the earlier static metadata audit and it leaves all statistical admission and proof methods unchanged.
decision_scope: Finite retrospective response-history header/schema extraction only; no matrix-value inference, event-level likelihood, candidate ranking, dynamic identification, empirical prediction or physical promotion.
assumptions: The response-history byte-freeze manifest is authoritative for product identity, role, locator, hash and length.
FITS scalar headers and table declarations are descriptive provenance; no matrix or EBOUNDS value is interpreted.
The two rsp2 files are an N0/B0 owner-candidate subset and not a complete multi-instrument timing/calibration pipeline.
The existing candidate-neutral estimator contract, T-054/T-059 methods, owner order and prospective-lock rules remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned rule linking each response segment to selected event windows and spectral-history validity intervals.
Calibration validity/interpolation semantics and the physical source of all response-generation inputs.
A detector-to-geocenter timing conversion and uncertainty for the GBM and GW instruments.
Frozen detector, energy, background and temporal windows with selection semantics.
A source-owned joint timing likelihood or component/shared covariance including calibration and intrinsic-emission nuisance terms.
A complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map and immutable scorer.
A prospective holdout not used for source selection, response selection or estimator design.

adversarial_review.check: Could the rsp2 segment declarations be treated as a timing likelihood or covariance?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: only headers and table declarations are admitted; response values, noise law and covariance remain absent.

adversarial_review.check: Could RSP_NUM=1..8 and ordered intervals prove a continuous calibrated response or interpolation law?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: numbering/coverage is descriptive; segment interpolation, validity and calibration uncertainty are not established.

adversarial_review.check: Could INFILE and detector labels be treated as a complete source-owned link to spectral history and geocenter timing?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: explicit linkage, conversion and uncertainty owners remain missing.

adversarial_review.check: Could two detector rsp2 files be called a complete multi-detector estimator?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED-FOR-SCOPE: the exact two-product intake subset is recorded and all four map stages remain incomplete.

adversarial_review.check: Could this response-history intake replace the established proof lanes?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: T-054/T-059, R-192 owner order and stopped-loop rules are unchanged.

boundary: EXP-001306 is a T0 response-history owner-candidate and schema advance. It does not admit response-matrix values, calibration validity/interpolation, detector-to-geocenter conversion, timing likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 exact byte/hash freeze, response-history header/schema extraction, independent PowerShell reproduction and hostile selected-hash rejection; no matrix-value or model test
next_action: Request or locate the source-owned response-segment validity/interpolation, calibration uncertainty and detector-to-geocenter timing rules. Do not read matrix values or score candidates until the statistical owner and proof-owner contracts are frozen; continue unchanged T-054 owner intake in parallel.
stop_or_redesign: If no owner supplies segment validity, conversion and statistical objects, retain HOLD-LC-001 as provenance/design-only and do not score.
If a future audit reads matrix or EBOUNDS values, issue a new version with an explicit candidate-neutral selection, uncertainty and leakage contract.
If a temporal observable remains invariant over the declared static-equivalence class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
If calibration, regulator or nuisance changes reverse a finite verdict, report UNSTABLE_FINITE_ONLY.
If the retrospective packet is used for tuning after target disclosure, do not award prospective credit.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted, selected, ranked, fitted or prospectively validated.
No source-owned response-segment validity/interpolation, detector-to-geocenter conversion, likelihood, covariance, nuisance probability law or complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map is present.
Exact response-history owner candidates do not establish a causal law, QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity identity or microscopic dynamics.
No physical vacuum, Reading-H branch, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The existing T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; this audit is additive and not a replacement.
